basics.name: Kavin M. Govindarajan
basics.label: Robotics Ph.D. Student · NSF Graduate Research Fellow
basics.summary: I study persistent planning and optimal control for robots that harvest energy from their environment. My research connects energy availability, information gathering, and long-duration autonomy.

work.name: University of Michigan · DASC Lab and CORE Lab
work.summary: Persistent planning and optimal control for sustainably powered robotic systems.
highlights: Co-advised by Dimitra Panagou and Chris Vermillion.
Study energy-information tradeoffs and periodic speed optimization for persistent environmental monitoring.
Develop physics-informed neural network methods for learning infinite-horizon value functions.
Connect information-aware planning with energy constraints for autonomous surface vessels.

work.name: CORE Lab
work.summary: Renewably powered robotics and underwater energy-harvesting systems.
highlights: Developed persistent planning algorithms for renewably powered vehicles in changing environments.
Conducted field tests of planning and control algorithms on a solar-powered autonomous surface vessel.
Designed and built composite control surfaces and electronics modules for an autonomous sailing drone.
Developed control software and conducted field tests for an underwater energy-harvesting kite under the DARPA Manta Ray program.

work.name: Liquid Rocketry Lab
work.summary: Student-led development of a liquid bipropellant rocket.
highlights: Managed financial and legal responsibilities for the organization.
Developed a dynamic model to support vehicle design and flight control.
Designed components for the rocket's guidance, navigation, and control system.

projects.name: Information Value of Energy
projects.summary: Periodic speed optimization for sustainably powered mobile robots, with a Chesapeake Bay salinity-monitoring simulation.

projects.name: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Persistent Control
projects.summary: Ongoing work on learned infinite-horizon value functions, with an interactive visualization.

projects.name: Clarity-Driven Adaptive Mission Planning
projects.summary: Energy-aware environmental monitoring with simulations and solar-powered vessel field experiments.

projects.name: Coursework Projects
projects.summary: Stochastic safety verification, wave-powered desalination planning, and autonomous sailboat modeling and control.

projects.name: Computer Vision-Aided Robotics
